title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
statementMd:
Find the largest sum of any **non-empty contiguous** part of the array. Kadane's algorithm does it in one pass: at each element, either extend the best run ending at the previous element or start fresh here.

**Input**
Line 1: `n` (1 ≤ n ≤ 10⁵). Line 2: n integers (|value| ≤ 10⁴).

**Output**
The maximum subarray sum.
hints: Keep bestEndingHere = the best sum of a run that ends at the current index.
bestEndingHere = max(a[i], bestEndingHere + a[i]); best = max(best, bestEndingHere). Start both at a[0] so all-negative arrays work.
